# @snowztech/ui-css

Vendored, unmodified CSS from the Snowztech UI package, version 0.8.0.

- Source: https://github.com/snowztech/ui
- Source commit: e5a50f79fc6b19b6aff636b930c784910af0bcf1
- Original file: packages/ui-css/dist/snowztech-ui.min.css
- License: MIT (included)
- Imported on: 2026-11-14 (byte-identical to the npm release on jsDelivr)

To update, build the chosen version of @snowztech/ui-css, replace the bundled CSS and license here, and update this record. Keep site layout rules in themes/snowztech/styles.css; do not edit the vendored bundle.
